verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Python and Node SDKs, a web playground and console, and OpenAI API compatibility, but no official Cerebras command-line tool. The llm-cerebras plugin mentioned by a community member is a plugin for a third-party CLI, not an official Cerebras CLI. SDKs are developer building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
